subject: Next steps: procurement gate + paperwork ownership
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Morris <evan.morris@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + who owns the paperwork (PO vs card / marketplace)

Evan — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so the procurement path is clear from our side: 

Call highlights:
- You want Redwood for embedding search and long-context summarization across two product teams (sales & ops).
- Primary blocker: internal procurement route decision (PO/credit card vs marketplace listing).
- Compliance: standard SOC 2 + audit log export will satisfy security; legal mostly budget/term questions.

What I can action this week:
- Share a PO template and a short SOW draft you can circulate to procurement (attached).
- Pull together a short note for your legal contact that outlines SLAs and data controls.
- Confirm marketplace listing timeline if that’s the preferred channel.

Questions for you / asks:
1) Who is the procurement owner I should loop in (name + email)?
2) Is finance willing to accept monthly card charges while marketplace listing is being evaluated, or do you need a PO for the pilot?
3) For deal timing: are you aiming to start the pilot before 10/1?

Proposed next steps:
- Evan to confirm procurement owner and preferred payment path by EOD Friday.
- I'll send the PO template + SOW and a one-page legal summary (by Wednesday).
- Marissa will draft the pilot SOW and confirm pricing if you choose PO route.

Attachments: Redwood-PO-template.pdf (stub), SOW-draft-v1.docx (stub)

Thanks — looking forward to the next note.

—
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
redwood.ai
From: Evan Morris <evan.morris@acme-analytics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + who owns the paperwork (PO vs card / marketplace)

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear note and the attachments. Quick answers from my side: 

- Procurement owner: Lisa Park (lisa.park@acme-analytics.com) — looping her here.
- Finance preference: they prefer a PO for anything over $10k; small pilots often go on corporate card but we need procurement approval first.
- Timeline: we’re targeting a pilot kickoff the week of 10/11; earlier if paperwork clears.

Lisa — can you confirm the internal steps? Typically we need: PO request -> vendor setup -> PO issuance. How long does vendor setup take once procurement has the PO template?

Thanks,
Evan

On Wed, Sep 15, 2026 at 09:07 AM Lisa Park <lisa.park@acme-analytics.com> wrote:
> Hi all — vendor setup usually takes ~7–10 business days after we get the completed vendor form + W9 and an approved PO (assuming no special contracting). If there are redlines on terms we may need legal review, which can add time.
> 
> Send the PO template and W9; I’ll start the vendor intake.
> 
> —Lisa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@acme-analytics.com>, Evan Morris <evan.morris@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2026 11:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + who owns the paperwork (PO vs card / marketplace)

Hi Lisa / Evan — looping in a short SOW + pricing note so procurement has context. A couple quick clarifications that help speed intake: 

- If you prefer PO route: we can accept a standard PO referencing Redwood’s tax id; our vendor setup checklist is minimal (W9 + contact).
- Marketplace option: if Acme wants to buy through the cloud marketplace, that often shortens onboarding but can change billing cadence and contract language. Let me know if you want me to pull marketplace vs direct summaries.

Attached: SOW-draft-v1.docx (pilot scope + pricing)

Next steps I recommend:
1) Lisa starts vendor intake with our PO template + W9 (attached).
2) Evan confirms budget owner for PO issuance.
3) Soojin and I will stand by to answer procurement/legal questions; we can provide a 1-page summary of data controls for legal if needed.

Ben — can you confirm the tax id and preferred PO text for the template?

Best,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Hi Lisa / Evan — checking in for a quick status update before EOD: 

- Did procurement open vendor intake with the PO template and W9 we shared? (Marissa + Ben attached).
- Any blockers on the legal review or preferred payment channel decision?

If helpful, suggested triage this week:
- Lisa to confirm vendor intake started (reply with intake ticket id if available).
- Evan to confirm whether finance will issue a PO or allow card for the pilot amount (~$6k).
- We’ll stand up the pilot immediately after vendor setup completes; can expedite with a one-off credit if procurement needs an extra week.

Links: HubSpot record (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890) | Pilot proposal (https://docsend.com/view/rdw-3749-sales-presentation)
